name: Colonel Kurzen
summary: At the Rebel Camp, Lieutenant Doren sends you against Colonel Kurzen and his inner guard. Their defeat could secure the rebels' survival.

sections.title: The Heart of the Stockpile
sections.body: Lieutenant Doren's defectors have reached the final struggle against their former commander. You have helped suppress Kurzen's elite specialists, but the rebels remain in danger while he holds his jungle redoubt. Doren sends you into the Stockpile cave, where Kurzen directs his forces beside his subchiefs and elites.

sections.title: Striking the Serpent's Head
sections.body: Lieutenant Doren needs proof that Kurzen has fallen. He asks you to bring back the rogue colonel's head and defeat his elites and subchiefs. The cave confrontation gives the rebels their only chance to breathe easier amid the dangers of northern Stranglethorn.

aliases: where to pick up colonel kurzen
faq.answer: After you complete Special Forces, Lieutenant Doren sends you from the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
Kurzen directs his troops deep within the Stockpile cave system, inside the Kurzen compound in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What proof does Lieutenant Doren require?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Doren asks you to bring back Kurzen's head as proof that the rogue commander has fallen, and to defeat his elites and subchiefs.
In Special Forces, you weakened Kurzen's specialized battlefield operatives. Then you turned toward his core command structure.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can help break a rogue Stormwind officer's grip on the northern reaches of Stranglethorn Vale by eliminating Kurzen.
